study: Q4 fine-tuned VLM + local controllers, real-hand evaluation (addendum)
provenance: Author supplied collaborator aggregate counts in chat, in object order Cube, Die, Ball, Duck. No trial-level records were supplied. Same object set and trial budget as the Q4 complete-system cohort.
interpretation_scope: This arm isolates whether the local waiting/execution controllers explain the real-hand margin of the complete system. The arm reaches 62.5%, below the fine-tuned system without controllers (66.25%) and 25.0 points below REVEAL. Under the stated protocol the controllers do not account for REVEAL's hardware advantage; the agent's inspection behaviour is the remaining candidate, which the simulation Q3 studies examine directly.
do_not_infer: transfer of the simulation controller ablation to hardware as a causal claim
a claim that controllers are harmful; the 3.75-point difference is within the precision of 20 trials per cell
